claim_text: After the Warsaw weapon he sees World War III headlines with everyone joining in, Russia holding coalitions with China, Iran and North Korea, America drawn in, and men and women lining up for a draft heading towards Europe, from a vision he dates to 2023.
quote: I saw a draft. I saw the men and women
falsify_match: A general war with an American draft.
falsify_miss: No draft. He dates the original vision to 2023, which puts an outer bound on when it was given but none on when it must happen.

claim_text: Poland getting involved and provoking Russia in the headlines, and he asks whether this is the event they are looking for to provoke Russia.
quote: They provoke Russia. They provoke Russia
falsify_match: A Polish action that draws a Russian military response.
falsify_miss: Poland stays out. He asks the question rather than answering it, which is his usual way of leaving a claim open.

claim_text: A black and yellow hypnotic wheel for false flag events involving Israel, with a boogeyman to be created because Netanyahu wants to push the button on the Iranian gas and petroleum facilities while Trump wants to negotiate, and they need a reason to attack.
quote: We have to have a reason to attack
falsify_match: An Israeli strike on Iran preceded by a manufactured pretext.
falsify_miss: Israel struck Iranian nuclear and energy sites on 13 June 2025 citing the enrichment programme, with no pretext later shown to be manufactured. The Trump-Netanyahu split he describes was being reported in Israeli media at the time, which he cites on screen.

claim_text: Great wealth in the Mediterranean off Gaza through oil, billions of dollars, with natural gas reserves and wealth beyond comprehension on the coastline of Israel and Gaza where the war has been.
quote: I saw great wealth in the Mediterranean by the go by the Gaza
falsify_match: Development of the offshore fields producing revenue at that scale.
falsify_miss: The fields stay undeveloped. Leviathan and Tamar are already producing off Israel and were public knowledge, so the reserve is not new information.

claim_text: Fish coming up on the shore gassed by poison because the earth is erupting on the ocean floor in the Pacific, the Atlantic and the Mediterranean, with earthquakes in diverse places and the ring of fire.
quote: gassed by some kind of poison
falsify_match: Mass fish kills traced to submarine volcanic gas across three oceans.
falsify_miss: Die-offs occur from algal blooms and hypoxia. This is the fullest statement of the mechanism he attaches to the dead fish material.

claim_text: Teaching that men's hearts will fail them for fear if they look horizontally rather than at Jesus, with an account of being told while driving on I-35 that great sobering days are coming and that the answer is to be filled with the Spirit.
quote: there's great day sobering days that are coming to this world
falsify_match: Not applicable; a framing for how to receive the warnings.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: A light on a half circle American flag on white buildings that look like the Capitol, in darkness, with America at a crossroads where great decisions are being made and great change is ahead.
quote: America is at a crossroads
falsify_match: A decisive national turning point traceable to a decision at the Capitol.
falsify_miss: Not checkable as stated. Crossroads and great change carry no content that could fail.

claim_text: The blessing and the wealth transfer seen on the people, at the same crossroads scene.
quote: I see the wealth transfer on the people
falsify_match: An identifiable transfer of wealth to the group he means.
falsify_miss: No such transfer. This is the shortest form of the wealth transfer claim, with nothing attached.

claim_text: He is told this is not only about America: God is dealing with America, with England and with Australia, and he notices their flags are all red, white and blue as they come up before him.
quote: I'm dealing with America. And I'm dealing with England
falsify_match: Parallel national crises in all three.
falsify_miss: Nothing distinguishes them from other countries. The shared flag colours are offered as the connecting detail, which is a coincidence of design rather than evidence.

claim_text: Very dark days coming in which governments in Canada, Australia, England and America enforce things on families and take away freedoms and the right to speak, with an exhortation to have a backbone rather than defer to the laws of the land.
quote: taking away your freedoms and your right to speak
falsify_match: Legal restrictions on religious speech enacted across the four named countries.
falsify_miss: No such restrictions. He argues here against the standard reading of Romans 13, which is the substantive part.

claim_text: An exhortation to be a David with a sword rather than lukewarm, invoking Normandy and standing up to Hitler, and telling those who want soothing words to go and watch another prophet.
quote: it's time to get some testosterone up in here
falsify_match: Not applicable; an exhortation.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: An old war plane with American air force emblems, then jet engines and jet fuel, then a space age AI car with unusual tyres that does not exist yet, and the letters AI appearing by the tree, with a new industrial revolution being birthed.
quote: a new industrial revolution is coming. It's birthing
falsify_match: A transformation in transport and industry on the scale the sequence implies.
falsify_miss: Change stays incremental. This is a retelling of the 21 May vision, which is the earliest on file.

claim_text: Told to look to the oak and its strength, then seeing Benjamin Franklin with his spectacles and the kite and key discovering electricity by the oak tree, with a great and revolutionary discovery about to come near.
quote: A revolutionary discovery. A revolutionary discovery
falsify_match: A scientific discovery of the order of the discovery of electricity.
falsify_miss: No such discovery. Near carries no date, and the Franklin imagery is a framing for the announcement rather than a detail about what is found.

claim_text: A figure described as the birthing child, the prodigal, a protégé out of whom much of Europe is coming, with his mind on another level, after which he stops and says he does not want to talk any more because he sees very dark things.
quote: He's the prodical child
falsify_match: A European figure emerging who fits the description.
falsify_miss: Nobody is named, and he stops the session rather than continuing, so there is nothing to check.

claim_text: The tree vision in full: old war plane, jet engines and F-16s, a space age AI car not yet on the earth, the letters AI appearing in front of the whole history of transportation, and a new industrial revolution being birthed, with the soil and foundation of the tree shown.
quote: a capital A lowercase I ai came into play
falsify_match: An AI-driven industrial transformation on the scale of the earlier revolutions.
falsify_miss: Change stays incremental. This is the earliest telling of the AI industrial revolution on file, ten days before the golden window version.

claim_text: Venezuela approached secretly through tunnels with an offer of rescue and friendship, and the same offer made to Cuba, North Korea and Iran, with a plan to overdominate the dollar and western culture that cannot be shown yet.
quote: We have a plan to over overdominate the dollar
falsify_match: A bloc forming around those four states against the dollar.
falsify_miss: No such bloc. Iran and Cuba were already deepening ties with Russia and China when this was given.

claim_text: An uprising in the Middle East like nothing seen before, with black swan events involving Israel and Iran trying to poke it, and an escalation of strikes against Iran, after which he says he feels instant caution and will not go further.
quote: I saw black swan events
falsify_match: Strikes on Iran preceded by an incident later shown to be staged.
falsify_miss: Strikes occurred in June 2025 with no staged incident established. He cuts himself off here, which he does repeatedly on this thread.

claim_text: He says the removal of Trudeau happened exactly as given, and prays that the new Canadian prime minister be visited and shaken in his sleep as Pharaoh was dealt with.
quote: I saw Justin Trudeau being removed. Happened just like you said
falsify_match: A recording naming Trudeau's departure before it was announced.
falsify_miss: No such recording, or one that names it only after his approval had collapsed. Trudeau announced his resignation on 6 January 2025 after months of public pressure and caucus revolt.

claim_text: Putin holding five large red and white playing cards fanned out, hiding behind them and watching Ukraine over the top, with World War III seen in black letters before that, then Germany, France and a NATO alliance.
quote: he was holding them out like a fan
falsify_match: Five concealed Russian moves revealed in sequence.
falsify_miss: The number five never attaches to anything. This is the earliest telling of the five cards on file, four months before the August version.

claim_text: Russia taking permanent control of the land it has taken through a peace agreement with a four year window, with the old USSR and KGB roots in Putin wanting the whole of Ukraine including Kiev, waiting for Trump to get out of the way.
quote: it was a 4-year window. I saw a time span
falsify_match: A settlement recognising Russian control, followed by a renewed offensive after the American term ends.
falsify_miss: No settlement, or a durable one. The four year window matches the presidential term rather than being an independent figure.

claim_text: North Korea siding with China as an Asian front using Korea as a linchpin, and his belief that Kim Jong-un and his sister will eventually be removed with revival following, alongside riots starting in China.
quote: I believe Kim Jong-un will be removed and his sister
falsify_match: Both Kims removed from power.
falsify_miss: They remain. This is the earliest telling on file, four months before the August version, and it is marked as belief rather than revelation in both.

claim_text: Riots in China being hushed down and spreading to other nations, and decisions in Canada that will suppress freedom of speech and bring a lockdown because of how they think versus how Christians think, with great persecution coming to Christians.
quote: great persecution coming to the Christians
falsify_match: Canadian legislation restricting religious speech.
falsify_miss: No such legislation. He notes he has had emails objecting to this word, which is why he restates it.

claim_text: He says his job is not to scare but to prepare and to sound the alarm, that he is accountable only to God and not to viewers, and compares himself to Jeremiah.
quote: my job is not to scare you, but to prepare you
falsify_match: Not applicable; a statement about his role.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though accountable to him only and not to you is worth recording as the standing answer to challenge.

claim_text: He says he is quick to admit missing it, then gives an economic disaster and a very big shaking coming to Canada, and connects the Eric Trump banking announcement and the move to eliminate the IRS to the digital platform window.
quote: I saw an economic disaster
falsify_match: A Canadian economic collapse.
falsify_miss: Canada avoids recession or has an ordinary one. He also states here that he says when he misses it, which is checkable against whether such corrections exist in the corpus.

claim_text: A warning attached to the elimination of the IRS: there is a catch in it, given before the public discussion of exempting people below two hundred thousand dollars, and tied back to the earlier warning about the Iraqi dinar and people not paying taxes.
quote: There's something there that's a catch
falsify_match: The IRS abolished or restructured with a hidden cost to taxpayers.
falsify_miss: The IRS continues. He does not say what the catch is, which leaves the claim as a general suspicion rather than a prediction.

claim_text: Trump seen leaving on an eagle, then negotiations with Israel and Hamas over Gaza in which the temple rather than a two-state solution is discussed, a peace treaty allowing the Temple Mount to be built, with oil dripping from a derrick across the Mediterranean.
quote: I saw the temple being discussed
falsify_match: An agreement permitting construction of a temple on the Mount.
falsify_miss: No such agreement. The Temple Mount holds the Al Aqsa compound, which makes this the least negotiable site in the region.

claim_text: Iraq rising from the ashes with new skyscrapers, shopping malls and housing developments, an economic boom and a major flow of finances, with the world economy shifting from China and America to Iraq and the Middle East.
quote: An economic boom is about to take place in Iraq
falsify_match: Iraqi GDP and construction growing at a rate that shifts regional economic weight.
falsify_miss: Iraq stays dependent on oil revenue with limited construction. The comparison he draws is to Saudi Arabia, which has an order of magnitude more capital.

claim_text: The Middle East becomes the breadbasket of the world financially and a superpower rises out of it as an economic hero while the world's economies crash, which he is told is the beginning stages of the antichrist.
quote: A superpower will rise out of all of this as an economic hero
falsify_match: A Middle Eastern figure gaining global economic leadership during a worldwide crash.
falsify_miss: No such figure. Economic hero and beginning stages are loose enough that Gulf sovereign wealth expansion alone could be claimed.

claim_text: He says he has already told viewers who he believes the antichrist is, and that this man will play a major part in the temple agreement with Israel, while Israel rises under the blessing of Abraham.
quote: I told you I believe who the Antichrist is
falsify_match: The named figure signing a temple agreement with Israel.
falsify_miss: He does not. Naming a living person as the antichrist is the strongest identification in the corpus and it is repeated rather than hedged.

claim_text: Fruit the size of baseballs and massive agriculture in Israel, a prosperity over their produce, as God breathes on the Abrahamic covenant to show the world he is still the God over Israel.
quote: I saw fruit the size of baseballs
falsify_match: Israeli agricultural yields or fruit sizes that are reported as extraordinary.
falsify_miss: Yields stay within normal ranges. The baseball comparison is specific enough to be checked against horticultural reporting.

claim_text: Teaching that the covenant with Abraham has nothing to do with Israeli politics or with Netanyahu, and that God does not change his mind about a covenant.
quote: It has nothing to do with the politics of Israel
falsify_match: Not applicable; doctrine.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it is the standing answer he gives to objections about Israeli conduct.

claim_text: A peace agreement cut in the days ahead with Trump, in which the Saudi crown prince will be a big puppet master, alongside talk of a global recession possibly worse than a depression.
quote: Prince of Saudi Arabia will be a big big puppet master
falsify_match: A regional peace agreement brokered with the Saudi crown prince at its centre.
falsify_miss: No such agreement. Saudi normalisation talks were already public and stalled over Gaza when this was given.

claim_text: He says America is not becoming great again but fading into a global new world order with a digital dollar, and that the window is only for gathering the wealth of the sinner to bring in the harvest, against those promising an American turnaround.
quote: a fading of America into a global new world order
falsify_match: The dollar replaced by a digital currency inside a global framework.
falsify_miss: The dollar continues. This is one of the few places where he sets himself explicitly against the optimistic prophetic voices, which is worth recording.

claim_text: He recalls being told he is being given the harvesting equipment now, meaning the glory and the finances to get it done, and that the window can be stretched wider into a door if believed for.
quote: I'm giving you the harvesting equipment right now
falsify_match: Funds arriving at the scale the harvest would require.
falsify_miss: No such funds. The window-into-a-door framing means the size of the outcome is attributed to how big the believer believed.

claim_text: Gas lines in America like the 1970s gas wars, connected to the pipelines in Iran and a crumbling of infrastructure financially, and to the Mediterranean oil and gas.
quote: the gas lines in America like the 1970s gas wars
falsify_match: Fuel rationing or queues at American filling stations.
falsify_miss: No shortage. The 1970s comparison is specific enough to check: those queues followed an embargo, not a price rise.

claim_text: Important papers being shredded and tracks covered in Ukraine as the mineral deals come to full manifestation, with other side deals branching off the main deal like a vine.
quote: Shredding evidence. An uncovering of things
falsify_match: Evidence of document destruction around the minerals agreement.
falsify_miss: No such evidence. The minerals agreement was signed on 30 April 2025, three days before this, so the deal itself was news.

claim_text: A realigning of infrastructure over Ukraine with rebuilding and construction contracts branching off the mineral deal, involving Democratic and Republican politicians of great influence whom he sees but will not name.
quote: construction contracts, and I see shredding papers
falsify_match: Named American politicians shown to profit from Ukrainian reconstruction contracts.
falsify_miss: No such showing. He says he sees them and will not name names, which removes the checkable part.

claim_text: Great judgment on those deceiving, Canadian politicians included, with a call for whistleblowers like the Edward Snowdens even though it costs them their lives, and for all hidden things to be revealed.
quote: So I'm calling, Father, for whistleblowers
falsify_match: A significant leak exposing the material he describes.
falsify_miss: No such leak. He asks for it in prayer rather than predicting it, and adds that it costs them their lives.

claim_text: A new venereal disease worse than AIDS arising by Quebec and filtering into New York and Boston, because of ungodly practices and what is done to children, causing infection so bad that sufferers are made eunuchs, with no cure, and judgment beginning in Japan over trafficking coming up from Mexico.
quote: I saw it up by Quebec and it filtrated into New York
falsify_match: A new incurable sexually transmitted infection identified in Quebec and spreading to the American northeast.
falsify_miss: No such disease. This is the earliest and most specific telling on file, naming Quebec rather than Canada generally.

claim_text: The third temple being negotiated and becoming more open, to be rebuilt in exchange for peace, with oil written in bold black letters across the Mediterranean on the coastline of Israel.
quote: The temple will be rebuilt
falsify_match: Public negotiation of a temple in a peace framework.
falsify_miss: No such negotiation is disclosed. The temple in exchange for peace formula recurs across tellings and is stable.

claim_text: A peace deal being negotiated behind closed doors at that moment with Saudi Arabia involved and a figure he indicates without naming, alongside the oil derrick dripping over the Mediterranean.
quote: a peace deal is being negotiated. behind closed doors
falsify_match: Secret negotiations disclosed matching this description.
falsify_miss: No disclosure. He gestures at a person without naming him on air, which is the same withholding pattern as elsewhere.

claim_text: Corruption pillaging the people's finances attached to key financial people in Iran, then an abrupt halt, and Babylon rising as a stronger Middle East, with the Mahdi as the precursor of an antichrist agenda and trillions of dollars coming up out of that area.
quote: a Babylon will rise. Babylon will rise
falsify_match: A Middle Eastern financial centre displacing existing ones, with trillions moving there.
falsify_miss: Capital stays concentrated in New York, London and East Asia. It started in this area and will end in this area is a scriptural framing rather than an observation.

claim_text: A new BRICS area to watch with a great deal of metamorphosis and change, the Arabs thinking differently, taking hold of crypto, new banking and everything new, with oil and gold seen.
quote: a lot of change grabbing on to crypto
falsify_match: Gulf states adopting crypto settlement at state level.
falsify_miss: They stay on dollar settlement. Gulf sovereign crypto interest was already being reported when this was given.

claim_text: An uprising out of the Middle East that will influence Africa and reach down into Venezuela and South America with tentacles, preying on the weaker, with Iraq to be watched and Iran shrinking back like an unwanted stepchild, not as strong in the alliance, while Saudi Arabia reaches out to certain others.
quote: An uprising out of the Middle East
falsify_match: A Middle Eastern bloc extending influence into Africa and South America.
falsify_miss: No such extension. Iran being weakened relative to Saudi Arabia is the checkable half and it did occur through 2025.

claim_text: Something happening to make Syria strong though there is darkness in it and Turkey is involved, with Syria seen as a person fatally wounded on the right side with the right leg blown off walking on a crutch, and Egypt named, forming a United Islamic Front.
quote: A United Islamic Front. Watch. A United Islamic Front
falsify_match: A formal alliance of Islamic states including Turkey, Syria and Egypt.
falsify_miss: No such alliance. Egypt and Turkey have been rivals across Libya and the eastern Mediterranean, which makes the pairing the hardest part of it.
